reproject_3d_points: reproject 3D points using camera extrinsic matrix to transform coordinates between camera views
project_3d_to_pixels: project 3D points to 2D pixel coordinates using camera intrinsics and focal length
sample_depth_at_pixels: sample depth values from a depth map at given pixel coordinates with nearest neighbour interpolation
extract_focal_length: extract the focal length values fx and fy from a camera intrinsics array
extract_principal_point: extract the principal point cx and cy from a camera intrinsics array
